claims.claim: Meta said Q4 ad revenue grew 27% in Rest of World, 23% in Asia Pacific, 22% in Europe and 18% in North America on a user-geography basis.

claims.claim: In Q4, total ad impressions rose 6% and the average price per ad rose 14%, with impression growth mainly driven by Asia Pacific and pricing growth helped by increased advertiser demand and improved ad performance.

claims.claim: Family of Apps operating income was $28.3 billion at a 60% operating margin, while Reality Labs Q4 revenue was $1.1 billion, up 1% year over year.

claims.claim: General and administrative expenses fell 67%, mainly due to lower legal expenses including a $1.55 billion reduction in legal accruals; Meta ended the year with more than 74,000 employees, up 10% year over year.

citation.source_text: Marketing and sales were approximately flat year over year.
